newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Metro sees more income from property.
newsitem.headline: Metro sees more income from property.

text.p: Department store chain Metro Holdings Ltd said on Friday it expected its income from property in Singapore to grow due to contributions from retail space at its site at Ngee Ann City in the Orchard Road shopping district.
But the company said in a statement, issued with 1996/97 results, that keen competition meant any further growth in the performance of its core retail division was likely to be marginal.
Metro earlier reported a big jump in its 1996/97 net profit to Singapore $11.90 million, from S$1.08 million a year before.
